summary: Show a native open dialog and return Electron's result object.

target.notes: Requires native platform dialog services; no Chromium dependency is inherently required.

caveats: Result shape is observable; do not collapse cancellation to null alone.
Platform security-scoped bookmarks may be present on macOS when requested.

tests.name: choose file
tests.expected_behavior: returns canceled=false and selected filePaths when a selection is accepted

tests.name: cancel dialog
tests.expected_behavior: returns an Electron-compatible result with canceled=true and no selected paths when user cancels
